title: Respectful Workplace and Anti-Harassment
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: States expectations for respectful behaviour and support channels.
details: Harassment, bullying, discrimination and retaliation are prohibited.
Managers should not promise absolute confidentiality.
The assistant may offer escalation but must not investigate.
employee_actions: Seek immediate help for urgent threats.
escalation: Urgent threats require local emergency and security procedures.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
